deniedGlobals.fetch: Use the typed Hono RPC client (hc<AppType>) instead of the global fetch (ts-axioms: no raw fetch).
deniedGlobals.process: Functional core must not read the environment — accept config as plain input; the shell reads platform/config.ts.
deniedGlobals.Date: Functional core must not read the clock — accept timestamps (epoch ms) as plain input from the shell.
deniedGlobals.Promise: Functional core must stay synchronous — do async work in *.repo.ts and pass plain data in.
deniedGlobals.console: Functional core must not perform I/O — return values and let the shell log.
deniedGlobals.setTimeout: Functional core must not schedule work — keep it synchronous data-in/data-out.
deniedGlobals.setInterval: Functional core must not schedule work — keep it synchronous data-in/data-out.

effect.message: Functional core must stay pure: model failures as Either/Option/Data tagged unions. The Effect runtime (Effect/Layer/Context) lives only in *.repo.ts / *.routes.ts / main.ts. Either, Option, Data and Schema are allowed here.

patterns.message: Functional core must not import imperative-shell I/O services (*.repo). Keep core pure; wire repos in *.routes.ts / main.ts.

A feature slice must not reach into a sibling slice's internals — depend on its published door (a service Tag + a shared Schema contract promoted to shared/). Modular monolith: modules talk through narrow doors, not back-channels.
